title: Coherent formal modules Coh(X, I), the completion functor, and systems with support proper over a base
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] whose underlying space is quasi-compact) and $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals (the ideal sheaf of a closed subscheme [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]). (1) $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ is the category whose objects are inverse systems $(\mathcal F_n)_{n\ge1}$ of coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent] with $\mathcal O_X$-linear transition maps $\mathcal F_{n+1}\to\mathcal F_n$ such that $\mathcal I^n\mathcal F_n=0$ and the transition map induces an isomorphism $\mathcal F_{n+1}/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F_{n+1}\to\mathcal F_n$, for every $n\ge1$; a morphism $(\mathcal F_n)\to(\mathcal G_n)$ is a family of $\mathcal O_X$-linear maps $\alpha_n:\mathcal F_n\to\mathcal G_n$ commuting with the transition maps. (2) The *completion functor* $\mathit{Coh}(\mathcal O_X)\to\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ sends a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ to $\mathcal F^\wedge=(\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)_{n\ge1}$ with the canonical surjections as transition maps, and an $\mathcal O_X$-linear $u:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ to $u^\wedge=(u\bmod\mathcal I^n)_n$. (3) For a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals $\mathcal K\subseteq\mathcal O_X$, an object $(\mathcal F_n)$ is *annihilated by $\mathcal K$* if $\mathcal K\mathcal F_n=0$ for all $n$; for a closed subscheme $Z\subseteq X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] with ideal sheaf $\mathcal I_Z$, $(\mathcal F_n)$ is *supported on $Z$* if it is annihilated by $\mathcal I_Z$ (likewise a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ is supported on $Z$ if $\mathcal I_Z\mathcal F=0$). (4) If moreover $f:X\to S$ is a morphism of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], $\mathit{Coh}_{\text{support proper over }S}(X,\mathcal I)$ is the full subcategory of $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ of the objects $(\mathcal F_n)$ such that $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F_1)$ is proper over $S$, and $\mathit{Coh}_{\text{support proper over }S}(\mathcal O_X)$ is the full subcategory of coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules with support proper over $S$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]; since $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F/\mathcal I\mathcal F)\subseteq\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$, the completion functor maps the second subcategory into the first.
